_comment: Canonical latest-version marker read by gephi_health_check. Bump on every release (part of RELEASING.md). server = PyPI gephi-ai, nbm = Gephi Java plugin, plugin = Claude and Codex workflow packages. nbm_sha256 = SHA-256 of the released gephi-ai-<nbm>.nbm, which the installers check the download against (written by bump-version.sh). nbm_needs_gephi = the oldest Gephi Desktop that installs that nbm (the plugin's gephi.version), set by bump-version.sh.
